title: 港股国庆后首日重挫，恒生指数跌2.60%，10年美债收益率触及5.34%高位
summary: 10月2日港股恢复交易，恒生指数收跌640.98点（-2.60%）至23,972.29点，为3月以来最大单日跌幅；10年期美债收益率盘中触及5.34%，创逾24年新高。国庆假期内美债利率大幅攀升、9月非农数据意外疲软引发滞涨担忧，内地南向资金仍处假期关闭状态，外围利空被集中消化。
why: 港股重仓标的（腾讯、美团、小米等）普遍承压；高利率环境压缩估值，卖put仓位需关注行权价下移风险。下周南向资金重开（10月8日）若美债收益率未回落，波动率或持续偏高，隐含波动率值得留意。

title: G7 agrees to release up to 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel reserves over four months
summary: G7 nations and IEA partners announced they will release up to 100 million barrels of strategic oil and diesel reserves over the next four months, with a front-loaded substantial diesel release in the first 20 days. The coordinated move, announced Oct 2 by French President Macron, follows Trump administration pressure to reduce fuel prices amid the ongoing US-Iran conflict that has pushed WTI crude to around $167/barrel. Goldman Sachs estimates the release offsets roughly half of the diesel price surge.
why: 大宗商品价格压力缓解有助于降低通胀预期，间接支持美联储暂停加息立场。油价下行对高估值科技股及消费股有正面估值效应，与持有组合的长期逻辑方向一致；但若储备释放规模不及预期或地缘冲突升级，油价仍有上行风险，需持续跟踪。

title: Warsh top Fed deputies step in to give markets a clear message after weak jobs data
summary: Following September non-farm payrolls that came in far below expectations, Fed Chair Warsh top deputies — Vice Chair Jefferson and NY Fed President Williams — stepped in with public statements emphasizing data-dependence and signaling no automatic rate hike at the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting. Fed funds futures now price an 84% probability of a rate hold in October. The 10-year Treasury yield pulled back from its 5.34% intraday high after the officials spoke.
why: 美联储10月按兵不动概率升至84%，是近期卖put策略最大正面催化剂之一。利率预期逆转缓解了港股、科技股的估值压力；但若本周CPI超预期，加息预期可能反弹，需紧密跟踪。

title: TrendForce：2027年HBM混合ASP同比涨121%，HBM4 12-Hi 36GB堆栈单价料达1300美元
summary: TrendForce预测2027年HBM混合平均售价同比上涨121%；其中HBM4 12-Hi 36GB堆栈单价将从目前约600美元升至约1,300美元（涨幅约116%），主要受益于AI算力需求持续爆发和产能高度集中于SK海力士与三星。HBM4 8-Hi 24GB单价料达800美元（HBM3E同规格当前约370美元）。
why: 对SK海力士（7709.HK南方两倍做多ETF）及美光（MU/MUU）直接利好：HBM ASP大幅上涨意味着2027年存储板块毛利率有望显著扩张；若英伟达Rubin架构出货超预期，需求端还有上修空间。当前持有的存储相关仓位可关注行权价上移机会。

title: Circle submits formal MiCA review consultation response to European Commission
summary: Circle Internet (CRCL) submitted its formal response to the European Commission MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) review consultation on October 1, 2026. The filing covers USDC compliance framework, reserve transparency standards, and Circle operational structure under EU regulation. This is a key regulatory milestone as MiCA stablecoin provisions came into full effect in mid-2024.
why: Circle（CRCL）正式参与MiCA监管框架审查，显示其主动拥抱欧洲合规路径，有助于USDC在欧洲市场持续扩张；对稳定币赛道整体是正面信号。GENIUS Act通过后，Circle的监管合规领先地位（相对于Tether）在美欧市场均有竞争优势，有利于股价估值。
